## FLUX.2 Klein Base (GGUF) + LoRA — Text → Image

### Model & nơi đặt file (ComfyUI/models/...)
| File | Tải ở | Đặt vào |
|---|---|---|
| `flux-2-klein-base-9b-Q4_K_M.gguf` (5.9GB) | [unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-base-9B-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-base-9B-GGUF) | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| `flux-2-klein-base-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf` | [unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-base-4B-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-base-4B-GGUF) | `models/diffusion_models/` |
| `Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf` (TE cho 9B, ~5GB) | [Qwen/Qwen3-8B-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-8B-GGUF) | `models/text_encoders/` |
| `flux2-klein-4b-uncensored-q4_k_m.gguf` (TE cho 4B) | đã có | `models/text_encoders/` |
| `flux2-vae.safetensors` | [Comfy-Org/flux2-klein-9B](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-klein-9B/tree/main/split_files/vae) | `models/vae/` |
| LoRA `*_FluxKlein*.safetensors` | `H:\006_Model\FluxKlein` | `models/loras/` |

```
ComfyUI/models/
├── diffusion_models/  flux-2-klein-base-9b-Q4_K_M.gguf, flux-2-klein-base-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf
├── text_encoders/     Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf, flux2-klein-4b-uncensored-q4_k_m.gguf
├── vae/               flux2-vae.safetensors
└── loras/             Ryonara3_FluxKlein9B_epoch_10.safetensors, Hoo_Ryo_FluxKlein_epoch_11.safetensors, ...
```

### Lưu ý
- LoRA train trên bản **Base** → CFG 4–5, 20 bước. Không dùng file `flux-2-klein-4b-Q4_K_M.gguf` (bản distilled, tên không có `base`).
- Chọn 9B/4B: bật/tắt group **Models 9B** / **Models 4B** bằng node *Fast Groups Bypasser* (chỉ bật 1 group). 9B đi với Qwen3-8B, 4B đi với Qwen3-4B, không trộn.
- VRAM 12GB / RAM 16GB: dùng Q4_K_M cho cả model lẫn text encoder. Không dùng Q8 9B trên máy này.
- Text encoder GGUF: nếu báo lỗi shape, kiểm tra lại đúng cặp 9B↔Qwen3-8B, 4B↔Qwen3-4B.

### Prompt 2 mode (chọn bằng Fast Groups Bypasser, chỉ bật 1 group)
- **A-Manual**: gõ prompt vào ô Positive / Negative.
- **B-TXT auto**: `Text_Splitter` đọc file .txt, mỗi đoạn cách nhau 1 dòng trống, `###` tách positive/negative. Tăng `index` mỗi lần chạy (hoặc dùng Auto Queue).
- Ô **Trigger word** được nối vào đầu prompt ở cả 2 mode.

widgets_values:
with the exact facial proportions, hairstyle and facial structure.
Create a realistic, high definition, A genuinely photorealistic nighttime lifestyle photograph of an adult man taking a mirror selfie in a bedroom. The result should look like an authentic photograph captured with a modern smartphone, with realistic human skin texture, natural anatomy, subtle imperfections, believable shadows, and accurate photographic depth. Do not make it look like CGI, 3D rendering, illustration, anime, or overly airbrushed AI artwork.
Subject & Pose
Adult male with smooth fair skin and a natural fit athletic physique and realistic body proportions.
Standing beside the edge of a bed in front of a large mirror.
Torso facing mostly toward the mirror/camera with a slight three-quarter rotation.
His left arm hangs naturally downward beside his body, with the hand resting casually near the upper thigh/hip area.
His right arm is raised, holding a smartphone vertically in front of his face.
Right elbow bent outward and slightly away from the torso.
Smartphone positioned around eye/forehead level and partially covering the upper-middle portion of his face.
Right hand naturally wraps around the phone with relaxed fingers.
Shoulders remain relaxed and slightly asymmetrical rather than perfectly squared.
Chest and abdomen remain relaxed with no exaggerated muscle flexing.
Hips positioned naturally with a subtle weight shift onto one leg.
One leg slightly more forward while the opposite leg remains naturally planted, reproducing the relaxed stance of the reference.
Keep the body position casual and spontaneous rather than a professional bodybuilding pose.
Head & Facial Angle
Head tilted slightly downward and subtly toward the phone, approximately 10–15 degrees.
Face turned slightly toward the mirror rather than perfectly frontal.
Chin naturally lowered.
Eyes directed toward the smartphone screen/mirror area.
Relaxed, neutral expression with a very subtle closed-mouth expression.
Preserve the natural facial proportions and structure from the reference image.
Keep the hairstyle consistent with the reference: short, naturally thick black hair with a soft side-parted/forward-swept fringe, individual strands visible.
Maintain realistic facial texture and natural skin variation.
Outfit
clean white fitted boxer-brief style underwear with a simple elastic waistband.
Preserve the understated white fabric appearance and natural folds.
No additional clothing or accessories added to the body.
Keep the overall styling casual and realistic rather than fashion-editorial or provocative.
Bedroom Environment — Nighttime
Transform the original bright daytime bedroom into a cozy nighttime bedroom.
Large bed positioned behind and beside the subject.
White or light-colored mattress and bedding.
Warm beige/tan pillow visible toward the right side of the frame.
Minimal pale-colored bedroom wall in the background.
Very subtle nighttime ambience outside the main lighting.
Keep the environment simple and uncluttered.
Add a small warm bedside lamp or concealed warm practical light outside the frame to create believable illumination.
The room should feel naturally occupied and lived-in rather than like a studio.
Lighting
Use professional but believable nighttime smartphone lighting.
Primary illumination: large, soft warm-white light source positioned slightly above and approximately 45 degrees in front of the subject.
Secondary very subtle cool ambient fill from the room/background.
Soft illumination across the face, shoulders, torso, and arms.
Gentle shadow underneath the chin and along the side of the torso.
Natural falloff toward the darker background.
Avoid harsh flash, blown highlights, excessive HDR, or dramatic cinematic darkness.
Preserve realistic skin tone and subtle skin texture.
Add a very soft warm reflection on the mirror and smartphone edges.
Overall lighting should resemble a well-lit bedroom photographed at night on a modern flagship smartphone.
Camera & Composition
Camera: modern flagship smartphone, comparable to an iPhone 16 Pro Max rear camera
Lens: approximately 24–26mm equivalent main camera
Camera orientation: vertical
Shot: full/three-quarter-body mirror selfie
Perspective: natural smartphone perspective with mild wide-angle characteristics
Camera height: approximately chest-to-eye level relative to the subject
Framing: subject centered slightly left of frame, with the bed and pillow visible on the right
Composition: preserve the approximate framing and spatial relationship of the reference image
Focus: subject sharply focused while the background has mild natural depth separation
Image quality: high-resolution, realistic smartphone computational photography
Dynamic range: balanced HDR with natural highlight retention
Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical
Photographic Realism
Make the image look like a real nighttime mirror selfie, not an AI-generated fashion photograph. Include subtle realistic details such as individual hair strands, natural pores, tiny skin variations, realistic fabric texture, authentic smartphone reflections, physically accurate shadows, slight lens characteristics, and natural tonal transitions.
Avoid: CGI appearance, plastic skin, excessive sharpening, artificial muscles, unrealistic anatomy, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, warped smartphone, floating objects, excessive bokeh, overexposure, extreme HDR, cartoon styling, anime, illustration, 3D render, fantasy effects, or artificial-looking i vertical 9:16 composition.
